description:
Team Myles O’Donoghue is delighted to present 46 Phibblestown Wood. This well-presented 2 bedroom, ground floor apartment benefits from its own-door entrance and is ideally situated within this established and popular residential development. The property offers bright and well-proportioned accommodation throughout.

The accommodation briefly comprises: an entrance hall leading into a spacious living room to the front of the property, with a kitchen located to the rear. The living room and kitchen are connected via double doors, creating a bright and open feel between the two spaces. The property benefits from timber flooring throughout the living room and kitchen, while the kitchen is fitted with incorporated units and provides access to the communal rear garden.

The accommodation continues with two generous double bedrooms, both featuring fitted wardrobes, and a family bathroom. The bathroom is fitted with a WC, wash hand basin and a white incorporated bath with shower attachment.
The property also benefits from a communal rear garden, providing a pleasant outdoor space for residents to enjoy. Non-designated parking is available to the front of the apartment.

Phibblestown Wood is conveniently located with a host of local amenities within easy reach, including shops, schools, childcare facilities, restaurants and a wide range of recreational amenities. The nearby Blanchardstown Centre offers an extensive selection of shops, restaurants, cafés, cinema and leisure facilities.

The area is well serviced by public transport with a number of Dublin Bus routes providing access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. Coolmine and Clonsilla train stations are also within easy reach, providing convenient access to the city centre and beyond. The M50 motorway is readily accessible, providing an excellent road network to North and South Dublin, Dublin Airport and the wider commuter belt.
